deprecated_yaml.description:
The Aruba device tracker YAML configuration has been imported. This integration now uses the Aruba Instant HTTPS REST API instead of SSH.

1. Confirm that the REST API is enabled on the master AP with `allow-rest-api`.
2. Complete any required reauthentication or TLS configuration from **Settings > Devices & services**.
3. Remove the Aruba platform from the `device_tracker` section of `configuration.yaml`.
4. Restart Home Assistant.

The imported integration will continue polling after the YAML is removed.
deprecated_yaml.title: Remove the deprecated Aruba YAML configuration

deprecated_yaml_import_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not import the Aruba device tracker YAML configuration because the new integration uses the Aruba Instant HTTPS REST API instead of SSH.

1. Enable the REST API on the master AP with `allow-rest-api`.
2. Add Aruba from **Settings > Devices & services** using the master AP or virtual controller address.
3. Configure port 4343 and TLS certificate verification as required by your controller.
4. Remove the Aruba platform from the `device_tracker` section of `configuration.yaml`.
5. Restart Home Assistant.

No Aruba presence data will be available until UI setup succeeds.
deprecated_yaml_import_failed.title: The Aruba YAML configuration could not be imported
